verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability ships AI features (natural-language interaction, AI SRE, AI-driven log parsing), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for model training or how to opt out. The evidence covers only ingestion, querying, monitoring and AI feature claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
